extraction_notes: Zener semantics preserved: nominal reverse breakdown voltage VZ = 8.2 V is paired with the tabulated reverse test current IZT = 5 mA, not with the forward-voltage rating.

The BZT52C8V2S row was selected from the BZT52C2V0S through BZT52C75S family table. Its inclusive VZ bounds are 7.7 V minimum and 8.7 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT is 15 ohm at IZT, maximum ZZK is 80 ohm at IZK = 1 mA, and admissible IZM is 5 mA.
The BZT52C8V2S row gives maximum reverse leakage IR = 0.7 microA at VR = 5.0 V and temperature-coefficient limits of 3.2 to 6.2 mV/degC at IZTC, with Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.

The six zener-characteristic points are direct approximate graph-read observations from the visible BZT52C8V2S trace labeled 8.2 in p. 3 Fig. 1 at labeled logarithmic-current grid values; source-axis current in mA was converted to A and no intermediate points were interpolated.

No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published for BZT52C8V2S in the supplied datasheet. The p. 3 capacitance, leakage, temperature-coefficient, and impedance plots are series-wide typical characteristics without a separate tabulated component-specific capacitance or reverse-recovery value, so no such values were assigned.

Maximum ratings include PD = 200 mW and forward voltage VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, both at Ta = 25 degC; junction and storage temperature limits are -55 to +150 degC and typical RthetaJ-A is 417 degC/W.
